2609.31056.title: Neuralyzing the Trace: Selective Representation-Level Unlearning with Contrastive Sparse Autoencoders
2609.31056.paper_summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted information while preserving a model's other abilities. In realistic settings, such as privacy requests under the EU GDPR, the target may be narrow, for example information associated with a single person. Behavioral forgetting alone may be insufficient, motivating interventions directly on internal representations. However, standard mechanistic-interpretability extractors are poorly selective for such targets. We identify an energy bias in reconstruction-based extraction, which favors dominant background structure over low-energy target-specific components. We introduce SCALPEL, a contrastive sparse autoencoder designed to learn more selective forget features. We show theoretically that contrastive training promotes target-selective features and that our selection score controls expected background knowledge perturbation. We validate SCALPEL experimentally on TOFU across Qwen, Llama, and Gemma, where it substantially improves over NMF and standard SAE interventions and is competitive with Gradient Difference and RMU, bridging mechanistic interpretability and fine-grained unlearning.
2609.31056.paper_summary_zh: 機器遺忘旨在移除特定信息，同時保留模型的其他能力。<lb/>在現實情境中，例如根據歐盟GDPR的隱私請求，目標可能是狹窄的，例如與單一個人相關的信息。<lb/>僅僅依賴行為遺忘可能不足以達到目的，這促使我們對內部表徵進行直接干預。<lb/>然而，標準的機械性可解釋性提取器對這類目標的選擇性較差。<lb/>我們識別出基於重建的提取中的能量偏差，這使得主導的背景結構優於低能量的目標特定組件。<lb/>我們介紹了SCALPEL，一種對比稀疏自編碼器，旨在學習更具選擇性的遺忘特徵。<lb/>我們理論上證明了對比訓練促進了目標選擇性特徵，並且我們的選擇分數控制了預期的背景知識擾動。<lb/>我們在TOFU上對SCALPEL進行了實驗驗證，涵蓋Qwen、Llama和Gemma，結果顯著優於NMF和標準SAE干預，並且與梯度差異和RMU具有競爭力，橋接了機械性可解釋性和細粒度的遺忘。
